description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only the message content (excluding metadata) to the next LogNode. It is used for simplified, on-screen log output.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter in the logging chain that outputs only the message content, omitting other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message to the next LogNode, passing only the message content with minimal metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
